title: Scalar multiplication of polynomial sharings
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $d\in\mathbb N$, and let $x,c\in F$ and $f$ be a function from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$. If $f$ shares $x$ using a polynomial of degree at most $d$, then the function sending each participant's share to $c$ times that share shares $cx$ using a polynomial of degree at most $d$.
hypotheses_covered: A share function $f$ on nonzero elements of $F$
